technical.summary: DTE shows multi-timeframe bullish structure with three white soldiers and strong moving average alignment, but weak trend strength (ADX 15.38) and extended oscillators suggest caution on entry timing despite positive momentum confluence.

fundamental.summary: No insider or institutional signals detected; earnings event in 14 days presents timing risk for position entry.

sentiment.summary: Broad market sentiment is a tailwind with fear-driven conditions creating contrarian buying opportunity; no congressional signals available to confirm or contradict technical setup.

risk.summary: FOMC decision already occurred (event_days_away: -1); elevated VIX at 30.5 and post-event volatility create unfavourable conditions for new swing trade entry in utilities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multi-timeframe bullish confluence (price above all MAs, three white soldiers, rising RSI across all timeframes, OBV confirmation) in fear-zone contrarian opportunity provides technical entry structure.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak ADX trend strength (15.38), overbought oscillators (Stochastic RSI K at 65.74, Williams %R), elevated VIX (30.5), unfavourable macro post-FOMC, and 14-day earnings event create uncompensated risk/reward for swing trade entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical confluence undermined by macro headwinds: weak ADX trend (15.38), overbought oscillators, elevated VIX (30.5) post-FOMC, and 14-day earnings event create uncompensated risk in utilities.
decision.primary_risk: Post-FOMC volatility spike with VIX at 30.5 and earnings catalyst in 14 days expose position to adverse gap risk despite bullish technical structure.
